findings.statement: Corporate segment generates the highest revenue among all customer segments.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with JOIN between orders and customers tables, grouped by segment and ordered by total_revenue DESC
findings.code: SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.order_value) as total_revenue, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
